serve: ws4 serve --dataset ws4/dataset_kc_h_v1 --runs ws4/runtime/kc_h --targets ws4/targets_kc_smoke.yaml --geometry ws4/runtime/kc_h/kc_blocks.geojson --topology ws4/topology.csv --patch-accounts ws4/patch_accounts.yaml --port 8766
caveats: Structural model, not a calibrated KC growth model.
Selection smoke applies the first available treatment to every block at offset 0.
Product yield curves are point estimates; features are 100-year space-for-time curves.
Patch account uses managed area, not a seral/opening criterion.
